content.title: Coachella Unveils 2026 Artist Lineup: Justin Bieber, Sabrina Carpenter, Karol G, David Byrne, Iggy Pop, Young Thug and More
content.text: Rob Moderelli on September 16, 2025 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival has unveiled the lineup for its 2026 event. Returning to the Empire Polo Club in Indio, Calif., on April 10-12 and 17-19, Goldenvoice’s venerable desert festival will feature more than 130 artists from across genres, led by headliners Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber and Karol G. Other top billings fro this year’s festival include David Byrne, The Strokes, Young Thug, The xx, Iggy Pop, Ethel Cain, Interpol, Alex G, Turnstile, Dijon, Laufey, Wet Leg, FKA Twigs, Clipse, Disclosure and Nine Inch Noize–likely a collaboration between Nine Inch Nails and the elsewhere-billed Boys Noize. Carpenter’s return to Coachella as the festival’s Friday headliner follows a memorable set at last year’s event and a monumental year of touring behind Short n’ Sweet and her newly released follow-up Man’s Best Friend. Bieber’s Saturday finale will arrive as both his first billing at the festival, his first US concert since June 2022 and the live debut of Swag and Swag II, the twin records he surprise-released over the summer. Karol G’s last Coachella set was her debut in 2022. Other notable artists on this year’s sprawling lineup include Devo, Blood Orange, Geese, Moby, Black Flag, Oklou, Wednesday, Foster the People, Royal Otis, The Rapture, Little Simz, Joyce Manor, PinkPantheress, KATSEYE, Teddy Swims, Suicidal Tendencies, Swae Lee, CMAT, Model/Actriz, Green Velvet, Röyksopp, Los Retros, Major Lazer, Solomun, Blondshell, Subtronics, DRAIN, Addison Rae, Noga Erez, Fleshwater, Lambrini Girls, Bedouin, Die Spitz, and Anyma, presenting the world premiere of Æden. The bottom of the admat mentions “The Bunker Debut of Radiohead Kid A Mnesia.” Passes for Coachella 2026 will become available this Friday, Sept. 19, at 1 p.m. ET. Find more information at coachella.com.
